description: Navigation toolbar for the scheduler. Named groups, in order: header-start (only with content), navigation (Today, Previous, Next), title, view, header-actions (only with content), primary (only when OnAddClick has a delegate) and overflow (the More menu, only when it has an entry). The title is the date popover's trigger (role=button, aria-haspopup=dialog, not a nested button) and the visible title lives in a div; a sibling sr-only span carries aria-live=polite. The view switcher is the core TmTabs Variant=Pill, and the scheduler body is the matching tabpanel. Typically used internally by TmScheduler.

parameters.name: View
parameters.description: Current view type.

parameters.name: CurrentDate
parameters.description: Currently displayed date. The Month title is this date's month.

parameters.name: RangeStart
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the range the title describes. The scheduler fills it from the same range it loads. Day and Timeline titles show this day; Week and Agenda titles start here.

parameters.name: RangeEnd
parameters.description: Exclusive end of the range the title describes. Week and Agenda titles cover [RangeStart, RangeEnd - 1].

parameters.name: OnViewChange
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks a view button.

parameters.name: OnPrev
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks Previous.

parameters.name: OnNext
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks Next.

parameters.name: OnToday
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks Today.

parameters.name: Views
parameters.description: Views the switcher offers, in the given order. Null offers every view. A View that is not offered is inserted at its canonical position so one tab stays active.

parameters.name: OnAddClick
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks the add button. The button renders only when this has a delegate.

parameters.name: OnDatePicked
parameters.description: Fires when the user picks a day in the title popover.

parameters.name: HeaderStart
parameters.description: Host content rendered before the navigation group.

parameters.name: ResourceFilter
parameters.description: The resource filter, rendered as data-tm-group=filter after the view switcher. TmScheduler supplies the core TmMultiSelect when ShowResourceFilter is set.

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Host content rendered after the view switcher, before the add button.

parameters.name: ShowHeader
parameters.description: When false, the toolbar renders nothing. For TmScheduler this row is the header.

parameters.name: Today
parameters.description: The day the calendar marks as today. TmScheduler passes its display-zone today.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: Instance id shared with the scheduler body, so the body's tabpanel id matches the active tab. A standalone toolbar generates its own.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the scheduler resolved. Mobile renders the compact row; desktop and tablet render the core toolbar.

parameters.name: HasActionBar
parameters.description: The mobile action bar carries Today, so the compact row omits its own Today button.

parameters.name: ShowPrint
parameters.description: Whether to show the Print entry. The More menu renders only when this is true.

parameters.name: OnPrint
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks Print.

examples.title: Standalone toolbar
examples.code: <TmSchedulerToolbar View="TmScheduleViewType.Month" CurrentDate="DateTime.Today" OnViewChange="@HandleViewChange" OnPrev="@HandlePrev" OnNext="@HandleNext" OnToday="@HandleToday" />
